The migration is complete and verified. Here's a summary of what was done.

## Migration summary

All Pages Router files were migrated to the App Router and the `pages/` directory was removed entirely. `tsc --noEmit` passes and `next build` succeeds with the correct route types.

### File mapping (Pages → App Router)

| Old (Pages Router) | New (App Router) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Root layout replaces both. `<Html>/<Head>/<Main>` → native `<html>/<head>/<body>`; `<title>`/meta/favicon via the `metadata` API (with `title.template`). |
| `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) | `app/page.tsx` | Async Server Component + `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` + `headers()` for the user agent + `cache: 'no-store'` fetch. |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps`, `revalidate: 60`) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | Async Server Component + `export const revalidate = 60` (ISR). |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths` + `getStaticProps`, `fallback: 'blocking'`, `revalidate: 300`) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `generateStaticParams` + `revalidate = 300`; default `dynamicParams` matches `fallback: 'blocking'`; `generateMetadata` for dynamic title/OG; `notFound()` replaces `notFound: true`. |
| `router.isFallback` loading state | `app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx` | App Router loading UI. |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | `metadata.title.absolute` keeps the exact "404 - Page Not Found" title. |
| `pages/_error.js` (`getInitialProps`/statusCode) | `app/error.tsx` | `'use client'` error boundary receiving `{ error, reset }`; the `getInitialProps`/statusCode pattern no longer exists in App Router. |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` | Route Handler (`NextRequest`/`NextResponse`). |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | Route Handler with async `params: Promise<{ id: string }>`. |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` | Added `'use client'` and full TypeScript types. |

### Replaced Pages-Router-only APIs
- `next/head` → `metadata` / `generateMetadata` exports.
- `next/document` (`Html/Head/Main/NextScript`) → native tags in `app/layout.tsx`.
- `next/router` `useRouter` → `next/navigation` `useRouter` (in the new `components/NavButton.tsx` client component, used for the `router.push`/`router.back` buttons).
- `getServerSideProps` → Server Component + `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` + `headers()`.
- `getStaticProps`/`getStaticPaths` → Server Component + `revalidate` / `generateStaticParams`.
- `getInitialProps` (error page) → `error.tsx` `{ error, reset }`.
- API route `req`/`res` handlers + manual `405`/`Allow` header handling → Route Handlers (Next.js returns 405 automatically for unsupported methods).
- Plain `<a href>` links → `next/link` `<Link>` for client-side navigation.

### Types added
- `types/index.ts` defines `Post`, `Comment`, and `ApiPost`.
- All new files are TypeScript (`.ts`/`.tsx`) with typed props, params (`Promise<Params>`), context values, and Route Handler return types.

### Build verification
```
Route (app)            Revalidate  Expire
┌ ƒ /
├ ○ /_not-found
├ ƒ /api/posts
├ ƒ /api/posts/[id]
├ ○ /blog                      1m      1y
└   /blog/[id]
  ├ ● /blog/1                  5m      1y   … (+9 more)
```
- `ƒ /` = dynamic (was `getServerSideProps`)
- `○ /blog` = static + 1m ISR (was `getStaticProps` revalidate 60)
- `● /blog/[id]` = SSG + 5m ISR (was `getStaticPaths` + `getStaticProps` revalidate 300)

One note: `next build` auto-updated `tsconfig.json` to add `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts` to `include` (standard App Router behavior); that change is left in place. The old `pages/` directory and `components/AppProvider.js` are deleted.
